title: Beta readiness checklist: SIEM-ready audit export
creator: Naomi Feldman
content:
Owner: Talia Benson (Program)
PM Owner: Naomi Feldman

Goal
Ensure the SIEM-ready audit export capability is operationally, security, and support ready for limited beta (3–5 customers) across Hosted + Dedicated. This ticket is the cross-functional readiness tracker (not a design/spec ticket).

Beta scope reminder (must be consistent across enablement + comms)
- Destinations: Splunk HEC, Datadog Logs intake, S3 delivery.
- Delivery semantics: at-least-once; downstream dedup expected via event_id (see ADR).
- Filtering: allowlist/denylist by category/action; actor/resource predicates where supported.
- Operational controls: pause/resume exports; checkpointing/retries; DLQ + replay tooling for operators.
- Non-scope (beta): Redwood Private / on-prem support; custom SIEM connectors; exactly-once guarantees.

- PRD: sources/confluence/product-docs/requirements/siem-ready-audit-export-beta-prd.json
- Config + filtering UX spec: sources/confluence/product-docs/design-specs/audit-export-configuration-and-filtering-spec.json
- Audit schema v2 + SIEM mapping: sources/confluence/security-and-compliance/audit-logging/audit-event-schema-v2-and-siem-mapping.json
- PII policy: sources/confluence/security-and-compliance/audit-logging/pii-redaction-and-sensitive-fields-policy-for-audit-events.json
- ADRs:
  - Delivery semantics + idempotency: sources/confluence/architecture-and-standards/decision-records/adr-audit-export-delivery-semantics-and-idempotency.json
  - Filtering model: sources/confluence/architecture-and-standards/decision-records/adr-audit-export-filtering-model.json
- Exporter architecture: sources/confluence/eng-platform/systems-and-services/audit-exporter-service-architecture.json
- SLOs/alerting: sources/confluence/eng-sre/slo-and-error-budgets/audit-exporter-slos-and-alerting.json

- Retention vs export responsibilities policy: sources/confluence/policies-and-process/data-management/audit-log-retention-vs-export-responsibilities.json

Target beta cohort (proposed; final selection owned by Naomi)
- Acme Banking (Splunk)
- Helio Health (Datadog + S3)
- Quantiva (EU residency constraints; validate region + filtering needs)
- Northstar Insurance (procurement/security addendum pressure; ensure disclaimers are explicit)

Readiness checklist (single source of truth)

A) Product + UX readiness (Console + API)
1. [DONE] Console settings page implemented with destination configuration + filter builder + status surface
   - Owner: Dylan Brooks / Chloe Martin / Svetlana Petrenko
   - Ref: ENG-5177, DES-311
   - Acceptance: create/edit/disable export; show per-destination status (last success, last error, lag); accessible empty/error states.

2. [DONE] Control plane CRUD API for export configurations is feature-flagged and enforces tenant isolation
   - Owner: Ethan Park / Benji Okafor / Amara Diallo
   - Ref: ENG-5132, PR: sources/github/redwood/pr-28766-control-plane-export-config-api-endpoints.json

3. [DONE] Status endpoint used by Console to display exporter health is shipped behind the beta flag
   - Owner: Chloe Martin
   - Ref: PR: sources/github/redwood/pr-28805-add-audit-export-status-endpoint-and-health.json

4. [IN PROGRESS] “Test connection” behavior defined per destination (what is validated vs what is best-effort)
   - Owner: Naomi Feldman + Dylan Brooks
   - Decision needed: For Splunk/Datadog, do we attempt a single synthetic delivery event (tagged) or only validate credentials + endpoint reachability?
   - Action: align with Security (avoid sensitive synthetic payloads) + SRE (avoid false confidence).

5. [BLOCKED] Customer-facing configuration API documentation (Admin docs) consistent with Console behavior
   - Owner: Elliot Price
   - Blocker: final wording on backfill limits + pause/resume semantics.

B) Audit event schema + semantics readiness
6. [DONE] Canonical audit event schema v2 includes stable event_id + category taxonomy
   - Owner: Marcus Lin / Kevin Osei
   - Ref: ENG-5127, PR: sources/github/redwood/pr-28741-audit-event-schema-v2-event-id-and-category-taxonomy.json
   - Note: confirm that schema v1 consumers are unaffected (compat mapping documented).

7. [IN PROGRESS] SIEM field mapping guidance finalized for Splunk/Datadog (including recommended index/source/sourcetype; Datadog tags)
   - Owner: Kevin Osei + Colin O'Donnell
   - Ref: schema + mapping doc (Confluence) + Datadog adapter PR notes.

8. [DONE] PII minimization + redaction rules applied to exported events; review checklist published
   - Owner: Marcus Lin
   - Ref: sources/confluence/security-and-compliance/audit-logging/pii-redaction-and-sensitive-fields-policy-for-audit-events.json

C) Exporter service readiness (delivery guarantees + failure handling)
9. [DONE] Exporter at-least-once semantics implemented with checkpointing + retries + backoff
   - Owner: Logan Wright (Telemetry) / Platform Eng
   - Ref: ADR + exporter PRs; S3 adapter includes checkpoint persistence.

10. [DONE] Destination adapters implemented and reviewed
   - S3 adapter: sources/github/audit-log-exporter/pr-1061-implement-s3-adapter-batching-and-checkpoints.json
   - S3 KMS + cross-account role: sources/github/audit-log-exporter/pr-1068-support-s3-kms-encryption-and-cross-account-role.json
   - Splunk HEC: sources/github/audit-log-exporter/pr-1074-add-splunk-hec-adapter-with-429-handling.json
   - Datadog: sources/github/audit-log-exporter/pr-1080-add-datadog-logs-adapter-and-tag-mapping.json

11. [DONE] Filtering engine v1 shipped (safe defaults) and config validation added
   - Owner: Jordan Lee
   - Ref: sources/github/audit-log-exporter/pr-1087-filtering-engine-v1-allowlist-denylist.json

12. [DONE] DLQ + replay tooling exists with guardrails
   - Owner: Logan Wright + SRE
   - Ref: sources/github/audit-log-exporter/pr-1093-add-dlq-and-replay-cli.json

13. [DONE] Backpressure controls and max-lag safety exist (auto-pausing behavior) 
   - Owner: SRE + exporter eng
   - Ref: sources/github/audit-log-exporter/pr-1119-backpressure-controls-and-max-lag-safety.json

14. [IN PROGRESS] Documented replay/runbook procedure for “customer reports missing events” including expected lag/backfill messaging
   - Owner: Rafael Mendes + Kira Thompson
   - Ref: SUP-18531 learnings; incident thread referenced in runbook.

D) Security controls + reviews (must-have for beta)
15. [DONE] RBAC permissions shipped and verified in staging
   - Owner: Kaitlyn Nguyen
   - Ref: ENG-5173; PR: sources/github/redwood/pr-28792-rbac-permissions-for-audit-export-management.json and sources/github/rbac-policy-bundle/pr-244-add-audit-export-permissions-and-default-roles.json
   - Verification: “Auditor” can view status but cannot edit destinations; “Org Admin” can manage configs + rotate credential refs.

16. [DONE] Threat model review completed; mitigations tracked and implemented
   - Owner: Marcus Lin
   - Ref: ENG-5189, slack: sources/slack/eng-security/1737395528.json

17. [DONE] Egress allowlist/destination validation present to reduce SSRF/exfil risk
   - Owner: Platform + Security
   - Ref: sources/github/audit-log-exporter/pr-1105-egress-allowlist-and-destination-validation.json

18. [IN PROGRESS] Secrets handling: confirm storage path (KMS-encrypted), rotation procedure, and redaction in logs/traces
   - Owner: Hanae Suzuki + Security
   - Output: short internal “how secrets are handled” explainer for Support + Sales Security.

19. [IN PROGRESS] Customer-facing security FAQ finalized (delivery guarantees, retention vs export responsibilities, encryption, regions)
   - Owner: Olga Petrov + Naomi Feldman
   - Ref: sources/confluence/sales-enablement/security-faq/siem-audit-export-beta-security-faq.json

E) SLOs, observability, and on-call readiness
20. [DONE] SLOs defined and approved for beta (initial)
   - Owner: Sean Gallagher
   - Ref: sources/confluence/eng-sre/slo-and-error-budgets/audit-exporter-slos-and-alerting.json
   - Current beta SLO targets (confirm in SLO doc):
     - Export lag: p95 < 10 minutes (per tenant/destination) over 24h window
     - Delivery success rate: >= 99.9% batches delivered (excluding customer misconfig/auth failures)
     - Adapter error budget: 0 paging alerts for non-actionable downstream 429s (should ticket unless sustained)

21. [DONE] Dashboards + alert rules merged and deployed
   - Owner: Logan Wright / Aisha Bello
   - Ref: sources/github/observability-pack/pr-392-add-audit-exporter-dashboards-and-alerts.json

22. [DONE] Runbook published and linked from alert annotations
   - Owner: Rafael Mendes
   - Ref: sources/confluence/eng-sre/runbooks/runbook-audit-exporter-delivery-failures.json

23. [IN PROGRESS] On-call training + game day scenario for downstream throttling (Splunk/Datadog 429) 
   - Owner: Rafael Mendes + Sean Gallagher
   - Input: sources/google_drive/shared_drives/engineering/site-reliability-engineering/audit-exporter-load-and-backpressure-experiments.json
   - Goal: ensure pause/resume + comms playbook are exercised.

F) Testing & quality gates
24. [DONE] E2E integration tests exist with Splunk/Datadog sandbox harness
   - Owner: Leila Farouk
   - Ref: sources/github/audit-log-exporter/pr-1112-integration-tests-with-splunk-and-datadog-sandboxes.json

25. [IN PROGRESS] Chaos scenarios + assertions on dedup/idempotency documented (what customers must do vs what we guarantee)
   - Owner: Leila Farouk + Marcus Lin + Naomi Feldman
   - Output: add a “Dedup expectations” section to FAQ + internal support macros.

26. [IN PROGRESS] S3 delivery testing matrix executed for cross-account + SSE-KMS + multipart failure injection
   - Owner: Diego Santos + Infra
   - Ref: sources/google_drive/shared_drives/engineering/infrastructure/audit-export-s3-delivery-testing-matrix.json

G) Docs, enablement, and support readiness
27. [IN PROGRESS] Internal CS/SE guide for Splunk HEC reviewed and updated for beta limitations + troubleshooting
   - Owner: Colin O'Donnell + Miguel Santos
   - Ref: sources/confluence/customer-success-and-support/integration-guides/splunk-hec-audit-export-integration-internal-guide.json

28. [BLOCKED] Datadog internal guide (equivalent to Splunk guide) created
   - Owner: Miguel Santos
   - Blocker: finalize Datadog key-scoping caveats and error mapping (see SUP-18497).

29. [IN PROGRESS] Support macros (customer comms templates) for common issues
   - Owners: Support + Kira Thompson
   - Must include:
     - “403/permission denied” (Datadog key scope)
     - “429/throttling” (Splunk/Datadog)
     - “missing events” (lag/backfill explanation; how to check event_id dedup)
     - “filtering taxonomy” response (categories list; link to docs)

30. [IN PROGRESS] Beta welcome email template + limitations (explicit)
   - Owner: Naomi Feldman
   - Must state:
     - at-least-once delivery; dedup required using event_id
     - beta support hours/expectations
     - no Private deployments in beta
     - backfill window/limitations and how to request backfill

31. [DONE] Retention vs export responsibilities language approved for SOC2/ISO questionnaires
   - Owner: Olga Petrov + Michael Grant
   - Ref: sources/confluence/policies-and-process/data-management/audit-log-retention-vs-export-responsibilities.json

H) Rollout plan and operational controls
32. [DONE] Feature flag + tenant allowlist + kill switch implemented
   - Owner: Connor O'Brien
   - Ref: ENG-5184; PR: sources/github/redwood/pr-28824-feature-flag-tenant-allowlist-for-siem-export-beta.json

33. [IN PROGRESS] Beta enablement process defined (who can enable, required checks, confirmation steps)
   - Owner: Talia Benson + Connor O'Brien + Support (INT)
   - Reference: INT-9012 (enablement request flow)
   - Must include:
     - RBAC verification (customer admin vs auditor)
     - destination validation + egress restrictions
     - initial health check (exporter status endpoint)

34. [IN PROGRESS] Rollback plan validated (disable export without losing audit events; safe resume behavior)
   - Owner: SRE + Platform

Exit criteria for beta start (hard gate)
- Security sign-off recorded by Marcus Lin + Dr. Aisha Rahman (threat model + PII + secrets + egress validation).
- SLO dashboards live, alerts routed, runbook published; on-call aware.
- Support macros ready; CS/SE enablement docs for Splunk + Datadog + S3.
- Customer-facing FAQ approved (Product + Security + GRC).
- Feature flag allowlist process operational (INT ticket path or admin tooling).
- At least one end-to-end validation completed per destination type in staging and in one production sandbox tenant.

Open questions (need decisions)
1) Backfill window for beta: final default and max allowed (and whether per-tenant override exists).
2) “Test connection” semantics: what we validate for Splunk/Datadog without introducing synthetic sensitive data.
3) Customer-facing language for “delivery guarantees” that is accurate and non-alarming (at-least-once + dedup expectation).
4) Regional constraints for Quantiva (EU): confirm current destination egress and exporter region behavior for Dedicated.

Risks to track
- Downstream throttling causing sustained lag and noisy paging (mitigated by backpressure + alert tuning; still reputational risk during beta).
- Misunderstanding of at-least-once causing customers to perceive “duplicates” as a bug (mitigate via upfront comms + guide + sample dedup queries).
- Secrets misconfiguration / key scope issues (Datadog 403 pattern) leading to slow time-to-value.
- Filter builder complexity causing accidental over-filtering (customers think events are missing). Need UX guardrails + “preview” or “recent match count” follow-up if feasible.

Next milestone dates (tentative)
- 2025-04-29: Security FAQ + retention language finalized (Olga/Naomi)
- 2025-04-30: On-call game day complete (Rafael/Sean)
- 2025-05-02: Beta start gate review (Naomi + Talia + Security + SRE)

Gate review attendees
